name: context-health
topic: LLM context windows and long-context degradation (context rot, MRCR, needle benchmarks) for current Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok models; per-harness context caps and auto-compaction thresholds; hook and transcript formats of Claude Code, Cowork, Copilot CLI, VS Code agent hooks, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Cursor; startup (initial) context size per model and platform: how much system prompt, tool schema and instruction-file prefix a model tolerates before performance drops, and the typical host prefix of each agent

volatile_claims.claim: Copilot per-model context caps and the 1M opt-in: GitHub publishes no per-model cap numbers; a 1M opt-in exists for most current models (Claude Sonnet 4.6+, Opus 4.8/5/5.5, Haiku 5.5, Fable 5/5.1; GPT-5.3-Codex to 6.1 Sol; Kimi K3) in VS Code and Copilot CLI only (`--context long_context`) (as of 2026-10-14)
Codex CLI effective window for GPT-5.5 (400K cap, reported 258K-353K effective)
Copilot CLI events.jsonl usage record shape (not a stable API)
Startup-context bands (models.json baseline.fractions, 10/20/30% of the effective window) are judgment estimates seeded 2026-09-05 pending evidence
CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=claude-vscode as the VS Code extension marker (L-008)
GPT-6 Sol / Luna windows: 1.05M total, 922K input + 128K output; input past 272K billed at 2x input and 1.5x output (secondary sources such as LiteLLM; openai.com returns 403) (as of 2026-10-14)

Opus 5.5 caps: Cursor documents a 300K default with 1M in Max Mode (no surcharge); Copilot states no default (200K assumed; its 1M opt-in is listed on supported-models but pricing shows only a Default tier) (as of 2026-10-14)
Selection-noise similarity thresholds (TF-IDF cosine 0.45 / 0.65) are uncalibrated inference; no study validates a lexical proxy
